title: Billable and Sales Representative stay as they are when Technician changes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, with Billable set to No and Sales Representative off.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Switch Technician off.
  3. In Billable, pick Yes.
  4. Switch Sales Representative on.
  5. Switch Technician on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The window shows the Technician toggle on.
  • Billable shows No and Sales Representative is off.

Step 2:

  • Billable still shows No and is not grayed out.
  • Sales Representative is still off and not grayed out.

Step 3:

  • Billable shows Yes.
  • Technician is still off.

Step 4:

  • Sales Representative is on.
  • Technician is still off.

Step 5:

  • Technician is on.
  • Billable still shows Yes and Sales Representative is still on.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R9: “Billable and Sales Representative work exactly as today. Technician does not change, gray out or require either of them, and neither of them changes Technician.”
  • Out of Scope: “Billable and Sales Representative. No new rules: anyone can still be billable or a sales representative, technician or not, and Technician never changes either of them. Billable keeps doing only what it does today (stamping new time as billable or not, and the Technician Utilization report filter).”
  • Key Decisions: “Billable is not used to decide who is a technician, and Technician never changes Billable. Billable is only one piece of release-day evidence that can turn Technician on, never off.”
  • Terminology: “Time Clock, Billable and Technician → three different settings on the staff member. Time Clock (a toggle): the person clocks in and out. Billable (a Yes/No dropdown): their time is stamped as billable to customers. Technician (a toggle): the person is offered as a technician.”
